candidate.user_submission: Di pikin dey 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe hard. No sign say e dey convulse now. Dem no talk say e don get convulsion before. Di pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. I count im breath for one full minute. Di pikin calm for di time wey I check am. E don dey cough for 15 days. Pulse oximeter no dey available. Im breathing rate na 35 for one minute. E no get chest indrawing. No stridor when e calm. E no get wheezing. E no get recurrent wheeze.
